mothman: Mothman: a tall lean humanoid figure covered in dark grey-brown fur, with TWO ENORMOUS MOTH WINGS spread wide behind it, broad and softly scalloped with dusky brown and grey patterning, a small featureless head with no beak and no muzzle, and TWO HUGE GLOWING RED EYES set in the chest-high shoulders. Standing upright, body and wings solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no trees, no forest, no scenery of any kind
antarcticseaspider: An Antarctic sea spider: a pale cream-white deep-sea pycnogonid with a TINY NARROW BODY and EIGHT ENORMOUSLY LONG SPINDLY JOINTED LEGS radiating out from it, each leg many times the body's length, with fine dark joint markings. Seen from above, legs spread wide and clearly separated. Isolated creature on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no seabed, no rock, no shadow
ahuizotl: An ahuizotl: a sleek black otter-like creature with dense wet-looking fur, small round ears, sharp teeth, and A LONG TAIL ENDING IN A HUMAN HAND that curls upward. Low-slung and muscular, standing on four webbed paws. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no water, no rocks, no shore
saharancheetah: A Saharan cheetah standing in side profile: a very pale, almost white-sand coloured cheetah with FAINT SPARSE SPOTS concentrated on the lower flanks and legs, a slender build, a small head with faint tear stripes, and a long thin tail. Paler and less marked than a common cheetah. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no sand, no dune, no ground
pyrelynx: A pyrelynx: a lynx of living fire, its coat burning orange and ember-red with darker tufted markings, a short bobbed tail, long black ear tufts, a broad ruffed face and glowing amber eyes, with faint embers rising from its fur. Standing in a prowling side profile, body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no ground, no fire, no embers underfoot
mantis: A praying mantis in side profile: a slender bright green mantis with a long thin thorax, TWO RAPTORIAL FORELEGS FOLDED UP IN FRONT of the chest, a triangular head with huge compound eyes swivelled toward the viewer, long thread antennae, and folded wings along the back. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no leaf, no twig, no perch
ringedcaecilian: A ringed caecilian: a legless burrowing amphibian that looks like a large smooth earthworm, its blue-grey body divided into MANY EVENLY SPACED RING-LIKE SEGMENT GROOVES along its whole length, with a small blunt head, tiny eyes under the skin, and a pale underside. Coiled in a simple S-curve. Body one continuous solid tube. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no soil, no ground
argali: An argali, the great mountain sheep: a heavy tan-brown wild sheep with a pale rump patch and pale muzzle, a thick neck, and ENORMOUS HEAVY HORNS THAT SPIRAL OUTWARD AND FORWARD IN A FULL CORKSCREW CURL on each side of the head, deeply ridged. Standing in side profile, body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no rocks, no mountain, no ground
giraffe_c: A giraffe CALF: a young giraffe, shorter-necked and leggier in proportion than an adult, with a soft tawny coat patterned in irregular chestnut patches separated by cream lines, two small furry ossicone horns, big dark eyes and long eyelashes. THE LEGS AND BODY ARE SOLID AND UNBROKEN throughout. Standing in side profile. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it - no grass, no ground, no savanna
manedwolf: A maned wolf in side profile: a tall reddish-gold canid with a black erectile mane along its shoulders, large upright ears, a slender fox-like muzzle, black stockings on the lower legs and a white throat patch and tail tip. ITS LEGS ARE LONG BUT IN NORMAL PROPORTION TO ITS BODY - roughly the same leg-to-body ratio as a large dog or a wolf, NOT stilt-like, NOT exaggerated, NOT spindly. The body is deep and the legs are sturdy. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it
wyvern: A wyvern: a dragon with EXACTLY TWO LIMBS AND NO MORE - a pair of great bat-like wings which ARE its forelimbs and carry the wing membrane, plus a pair of powerful clawed hind legs it stands on. IT HAS NO ARMS: there are no separate front legs, no hands, no gripping forelimbs of any kind, and nothing but wing where an arm would be. A long barbed tail, a horned reptilian head, green-bronze scales. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it
reindeer: A reindeer standing in side profile: a stocky arctic deer with a thick brown-and-cream winter coat, a pale neck ruff, broad branching antlers, and short sturdy legs with wide splayed hooves. ITS MUZZLE IS BROAD, BLUNT AND FULLY FURRED - a proper rounded deer's nose with two small dark nostrils, correctly formed and symmetrical, not pinched, not elongated, not distorted. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it
babirusa: A babirusa: a near-hairless grey-brown wild pig with a barrel body, thin legs and a wrinkled hide. ITS TUSKS ARE THE KEY FEATURE AND THEY CURL: the upper tusks grow straight UP THROUGH THE TOP OF THE SNOUT and then CURVE BACKWARD IN A DEEP ARC toward the forehead like a pair of hooks, and the lower tusks also sweep upward in a curve. Strongly curled and arcing, NOT straight, NOT spike-like. Side profile. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it
